body:
FYI, the approach of PR #101788 is to adopt the delta of one of the two.

This PR respects both deltas by predicting the TimeScale (if the delta of the shot port animation is 0, the delta of the NodeOneShot side is preferred).

body:
If it is 0, the fading/transition will not be performed because the delta to proceed the fade will be 0. Therefore, the fade must be proceeded with some delta.

And if a downstream time scale of greater than 0 is not taken into account, the problem of interrupted fades in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/87009 should recur.
